x-m-e6-07.title: Kuchengeta kuravira kwemukaka we strawberry kwakafanana kana uchigadzira zvakawanda
x-m-e6-07.goal: Tarisa nedata kuti kuwedzera huwandu nekuwedzera nhamba imwe chete kunochinja kuravira, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako neproportion inochengeta reshiyo yakafanana.
x-m-e6-07.material: Suyeon akagadzira syrup yemukaka we strawberry nemakapu e3 estrawberry nemakapu e2 emukaka, uye kuravira kwakanga kwakakodzera. Anoda kugadzira zvakawanda nekuravira kumwe chete, uye Suyeon anofunga, “Kana ndikawedzera makapu e3 mamwe estrawberry, ndinongowedzera makapu e3 mamwe emukaka.”
x-m-e6-07.thinking.0: Gadzirisa pfungwa yako yekutanga uchishandisa data itsva
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.prompt: Data inoratidzwa chidimbu nechidimbu. Nguva imwe neimwe, sarudza zvaunofunga.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.hint.0: Panhanho imwe neimwe, nyora reshiyo yestrawberry kumukaka nenzira imwe chete uye ufananidze.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.hint.1: Siyanisa kuti panhanho ipi wakafunga “nguva dzingani yakawanda” uye panhanho ipi wakafunga “makapu mangani akawanda.”
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.0.info: Uchishandisa nzira yaSuyeon, akagadzira nemakapu e6 estrawberry (makapu e3 akawedzerwa) nemakapu e5 emukaka (makapu e3 akawedzerwa), uye kuravira kwemukaka kwakanga kwakasimba zvikuru kupfuura kwekutanga.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.0.after: 3:2 zvinoreva kuti estrawberry i nguva 1.5 yemukaka, uye 6:5 zvinoreva nguva 1.2, saka reshiyo yakachinja. Kuwedzera nhamba imwe chete kunogona kusachengeta reshiyo.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Kwakanga kuri kungoitika, saka edza nzira imwe chete kamwe zvakare
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Kana mhedzisiro ichiita seyinoshamisa, unogona kutarisa nzira pachayo usati wapomera mukana.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Tarisa kana reshiyo yestrawberry kumukaka, 3:2, yakachinja mu6:5
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Mhedzisiro yatokotamira kumukaka, saka kuwedzera mukaka wakawanda kunoitora kure zvakanyanya.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.1.info: Akaita estrawberry nguva 2 (makapu e6) uye mukaka nguva 2 (makapu e4), uye kuravira kwakanga kwakafanana nekwekutanga.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.1.ask: Kuti uwane kuravira kumwe chete nemakapu e9 estrawberry, makapu emukaka mangani anodiwa?
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.1.after: Makapu e3 estrawberry akava makapu e9, nguva 3 yakawanda, saka makapu e2 emukaka anofanirawo kuva nguva 3 yakawanda, makapu e6. 3:2 = 9:6.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wakaita estrawberry nguva 3 yakawanda, saka wakaita mukaka nguva 3 yakawanda futi. Iyo ndiyo pfungwa yekuchengeta reshiyo 3:2.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Estrawberry yakawedzera nemakapu e6, saka wakawedzera mukaka nemakapu e6. Uri kushandisa pfungwa yekutanga, “wedzera nhamba imwe chete,” zvakare.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wakafungidzira chimwe pakati pestrawberry nemukaka. Haina kuongorora kana 3:2 yakachengetwa.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.2.info: Panguva ino anoda kushandisa makapu e4.5 estrawberry. Achidaidza huwandu hwemukaka kuti □ makapu, akagadzira proportion 3 : 2 = 4.5 : □.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.2.after: Muproportion, product yenhamba mbiri dzekunze inoenzana neproduct yenhamba mbiri dzemukati. 3 × □ = 2 × 4.5, saka □ = 3.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wakachinjana mazwi ekunze nemazwi emukati pakuwanza. Tarisa zvakare kuti nhamba dzipi dzakaitwa mapairi pakuwanza kweproportion.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Estrawberry yakawedzera nemakapu e1.5, saka wakawedzera makapu e1.5 kumukakawo. Wakadzokera kupfungwa yekutanga.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wakashandisa chivakwa chekuti product yemazwi ekunze inoenzana neproduct yemazwi emukati.
x-m-e6-07.s.s1.reflect: Chii chakasiyana pakati peapo pawakatanga kufunga “ingowedzera nhamba imwe chete” neapo pawakagadzira proportion pakupedzisira? Ndeipi mhedzisiro yakakuchinjisa pfungwa?
x-m-e6-07.s.s2.prompt: Taurira Suyeon nenzira pfupi nzira yekugadzira zvakawanda nekuravira kumwe chete.
x-m-e6-07.s.s2.hint.0: Isa mumashoko ako kuti wakashandisa estrawberry nguva dzingani yakawanda.
x-m-e6-07.s.s2.hint.1: Pa muenzaniso nenhamba yakagadzirwa uchishandisa nzira yako.
x-m-e6-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakataura musiyano pakati penzira yekuwedzera nenzira yekuwanza here?
x-m-e6-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Mumuenzaniso wako, reshiyo yakachengetwa chaizvo pa3:2 here?
x-m-e6-07.s.s2.model.0: Kana ukaita estrawberry nguva 2, unofanira kuita mukaka nguva 2 futi. Seye 3:2 → 6:4.
x-m-e6-07.s.s2.model.1: Haufanire kuwedzera; unofanira kuwanza kuchengeta reshiyo yakafanana. Nemakapu e9 estrawberry, mukaka i makapu e6.

x-m-e6-03.title: Concentrate yakawanda zvinoreva juice yakasimba here?
x-m-e6-03.goal: Ratidza nemuenzaniso unopikisa kuti mutauro unoti “iya ine concentrate yakawanda inogara yakasimba” hauna kugara wakarurama, uye utsanangure kuti nei unofanira kuenzanisa uchishandisa ratio ye concentrate kuhwose.
x-m-e6-03.material: Pachitoro che juice, ma juice maviri akagadzirwa nekusanganisa concentrate nemvura uchishandisa kapu imwe chete. Juice A inoshandisa makapu 3 e concentrate nemakapu 5 emvura, uye Juice B inoshandisa makapu 4 e concentrate nemakapu 8 emvura. Hajun akati, “B ine concentrate yakawanda, makapu 4, saka B yakasimba!” (Pano, “yakasimba” zvinoreva kuti kana ukanwa huwandu hwakafanana, mune concentrate yakawanda.)
x-m-e6-03.prereq.0: Zvinoreva ratio ne rate (huwandu hunoenzaniswa nehuwandu hwe base)
x-m-e6-03.prereq.1: Kuenzanisa hukuru hwema fraction nenhamba dzakazara dze digit imwe nemaviri
x-m-e6-03.s.s1.hint.0: Kana ukanwa huwandu hwakafanana (semuenzaniso, kapu imwe), concentrate iri mukati yakawanda sei?
x-m-e6-03.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kuti huwandu hwose hwema juice maviri hwakafanana here.
x-m-e6-03.s.s1.o.a: Zvakarurama. Juice ine concentrate yakawanda inogara yakasimba
x-m-e6-03.s.s1.r.a: Wakangotarisa chinhu chimwe chete, huwandu hwe concentrate. Edza kuti mhedziso imwe chete inoshanda here kana huwandu hwose hwakasanganiswa hwakasiyana.
x-m-e6-03.s.s1.o.b: Aiwa. Unofanira kuenzanisa kuti concentrate ingani muhwose hwemusanganiswa, kwete huwandu hwemakapu e concentrate
x-m-e6-03.s.s1.r.b: Wakaisa chiyero chinotarisa concentrate nehuwandu hwose pamwe chete.
x-m-e6-03.s.s1.o.c: Aiwa. Juice yakawedzerwa mvura shoma inogara ichinzi yakasimba
x-m-e6-03.s.s1.r.c: Wakatarisa huwandu hwemvura oga. Mhedziso inoita sekunge yakarurama panguva ino, asi iyedze nenhamba dzimwe zvakare.
x-m-e6-03.s.s1.explain: Kusimba kwe juice hakuvi nekuda kwe concentrate chete asi nekuti concentrate yakawanda sei zvichienzaniswa nehwose hwemusanganiswa. A ine makapu 3 pamakapu 8 zvose, uye B ine makapu 4 pamakapu 12 zvose.
x-m-e6-03.s.s2.prompt: Sezvakataurwa naHajun, gadzira nyaya 2 apo Juice A yakasimba kunyangwe concentrate yakawanda yakaiswa muJuice B, uchishandisa nhamba dzakasiyana nedzirimudambudziko (A: makapu 3 nemakapu 5, B: makapu 4 nemakapu 8). (Huwandu hwemakapu ndenhamba dzakasikwa dze20 kana pasi.)
x-m-e6-03.s.s2.hint.0: B inoda concentrate yakawanda, saka chii chinoitika kana ukaisawo mvura yakawanda mu B?
x-m-e6-03.s.s2.hint.1: Pa juice imwe neimwe, nyora kuti concentrate ingani muhwose sekuparadzanisa kana fraction, uye uienzanise.
x-m-e6-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Huwandu hwemakapu ndenhamba dzakazara kubva ku1 kusvika ku20.
x-m-e6-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Huwandu hwemakapu hunofanira kuva nhamba yakazara kubva ku1 kusvika ku20.
x-m-e6-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Concentrate ya B inofanira kuva yakawanda kupfuura concentrate ya A.
x-m-e6-03.s.s2.fail.c3: A haisi yakasimba. Enzanisa kuti concentrate yakawanda sei zvichienzaniswa nehuwandu hwose.
x-m-e6-03.s.s2.fail.c4: Idzi ndidzo nhamba dzirimudambudziko (3, 5, 4, 8). Edza kugadzira nenhamba dzimwe.
x-m-e6-03.s.s2.explain: Gadzira idzva, kwete nhamba dzirimudambudziko. Semuenzaniso, kana A ine makapu 2 e concentrate nemakapu 2 emvura, 2/4=0.5, uye kana B ine makapu 3 e concentrate nemakapu 6 emvura, 3/9=anenge 0.333, saka A yakasimba kunyangwe B ine concentrate yakawanda. Makapu 3 nemakapu 5 nemakapu 4 nemakapu 9 (3/8=0.375, 4/13=anenge 0.308) inoshandawo.
x-m-e6-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Unoda kuudza Hajun, “Izvo hazvigari zvakarurama.” Tsanangura uchishandisa nhamba dziri mumuenzaniso wawakagadzira.
x-m-e6-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Isa mumashoko ako zvaunofanira kutarisa pamwe chete ne “huwandu hwe concentrate.”
x-m-e6-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Mumuenzaniso wako, nhamba dzinoratidza kuti nei A yakasimba here?
x-m-e6-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakataura kuti “ine concentrate yakawanda” ne “yakasimba” hazvireve chinhu chimwe chete here?
x-m-e6-03.s.s2.because.model.0: Usatarise huwandu hwe concentrate chete. Unofanira kutarisa ratio ye concentrate kuhuwandu hwose; A ndi3/8 uye B ndi4/12, saka Juice A yakasimba.
x-m-e6-03.s.s2.because.model.1: B ine concentrate yakawanda, asi mvura yakawandawo. A ndi3 makapu pa8 uye B ndi4 makapu pa12, saka kana ukaenzanisa ma ratio, A yakasimba.

x-m-e6-04.title: Win rate yaani yakakwira?
x-m-e6-04.goal: Ziva kuti kuenzanisa ma win rate, huwandu hwekukunda hahukwani uye huwandu hwose hwemitambo hunodiwa, uye utsvage huwandu hwakawanda hwemitambo hunosangana nemamiriro.
x-m-e6-04.material: Mu kickball league, Class A yakunda nguva 12 kusvika zvino uye Class B yakunda nguva 9. Seoyun akati, “Class A yakunda nguva 3 dzakawanda, saka Class A yakanaka kupfuura!” Win rate ndiyo ratio yemitambo yakahwinwa kumitambo yose yakatambwa.
x-m-e6-04.prereq.0: Zvinoreva rate, uye kunyora rate se fraction kana decimal
x-m-e6-04.s.s1.prompt: Kuti uzive kuti class ipi ine win rate yakakwira, chii chaunoda kuziva kunze kwehuwandu hwekukunda? Sarudza mhinduro imwe yakanakisa.
x-m-e6-04.s.s1.hint.0: Funga kuti kukunda 12 ne9 kwakaverengwa pa base imwe chete here.
x-m-e6-04.s.s1.hint.1: Taura kuti “base quantity” ye win rate ndeyei.
x-m-e6-04.s.s1.o.a: Mhedzisiro yemitambo kana makirasi maviri akatambirana
x-m-e6-04.s.s1.r.a: Mhedzisiro yemitambo pakati pawo chikamu chete chehwose. Win rate inoverengwa pamitambo yose yakatambwa neclass.
x-m-e6-04.s.s1.r.b: Huwandu hwevadzidzi hahusi base quantity ye win rate. Funga kuti huwandu hupi ibase ye win rate.
x-m-e6-04.s.s1.o.c: Huwandu hwose hwemitambo yakatambwa ne Class A ne Class B imwe neimwe
x-m-e6-04.s.s1.r.c: Wakaona kuti huwandu hwekukunda hunofanira kuenzaniswa pa base imwe chete (huwandu hwose hwemitambo).
x-m-e6-04.s.s1.o.d: Huwandu hwekurasikirwa kwe Class A ne Class B
x-m-e6-04.s.s1.r.d: Wakaona kuti kuwedzera kukunda nekurasikirwa kunopa huwandu hwose hwemitambo.
x-m-e6-04.s.s1.explain: Win rate inoenzanisa huwandu hwekukunda nehuwandu hwose hwemitambo, saka unoda huwandu hwose hwemitambo. Kana uchiziva kurasikirwa, unogonawo kutsvaga huwandu hwose hwemitambo, saka ndiruzivo rwakafanana.
x-m-e6-04.s.s1.acc.0: Kana uchiziva kurasikirwa, unogona kuwedzera kukunda kuti uwane huwandu hwose hwemitambo, saka izvo zvakakwana kutsvaga win rate.
x-m-e6-04.s.s2.prompt: Class B yakunda 9 pamitambo yayo 15 zvose. Class A yakunda nguva 12. Kuti win rate ya Class A ive yakakwira kupfuura ya Class B, Class A ingangova yakatamba mitambo mingani zvose? Tsvaga huwandu 3 hunogoneka hwemitambo.
x-m-e6-04.s.s2.hint.0: Kutanga nyora win rate ya Class B se fraction kana decimal.
x-m-e6-04.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza huwandu hwose hwemitambo, uparadzanise 12 nahwo, uye uenzanise nekukosha kwa Class B.
x-m-e6-04.s.s2.var.n: Huwandu hwose hwemitambo ya Class A
x-m-e6-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Class A yakunda nguva 12, saka huwandu hwose hwemitambo inhamba yakazara iri 12 kana kupfuura.
x-m-e6-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Haigoni kuva shoma kupfuura mitambo 12 yatokundwa. Inofanira kuva nhamba yakazara.
x-m-e6-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Win rate ya Class A yakakwira kupfuura ya Class B.
x-m-e6-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Win rate ya Class A haina kukwira kupfuura ya Class B (9/15).
x-m-e6-04.s.s2.explain: Win rate ya Class B ndi9/15 = 0.6. Kuti 12/n ya Class A ive huru kupfuura 0.6, n inofanira kuva diki kupfuura 20, saka n imwe neimwe kubva ku12 kusvika ku19 inogoneka.
x-m-e6-04.s.s2.because.prompt: Tsanangura nekuenzanisa ma win rate kuti nei huwandu hwose hwemitambo 20 husingashande.
x-m-e6-04.s.s2.because.hint.0: Tsvaga win rate ya Class A kumitambo 20.
x-m-e6-04.s.s2.because.hint.1: Isa kukosha uku padivi pe win rate ya Class B.
x-m-e6-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakatarisa kuti makosha maviri awakaverenga akaenzana chaizvo here?
x-m-e6-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakataura musiyano pakati pe “inofanira kuva yakakwira” ne “yakaenzana” here?

x-m-e6-04.s.s2.because.model.1: Nemitambo 20, win rate ya Class A inewo 60% uye win rate ya Class B ndi60%, saka dzakafanana. Kana dzakaenzana, haugoni kutaura kuti Class A yakakwira.

x-m-e6-08.title: Kana diameter ikaita nguva 2, nzvimbo inoitawo nguva 2 here?
x-m-e6-08.goal: Tsvaga kukanganisa muchigadziriso uye ufananidze kuti uone kuti kana diameter ikaita nguva 2, nzvimbo yedenderedzwa haingoiti nguva 2 chete asi inokura zvakanyanya, uye utsanangure kuti nei.
x-m-e6-08.material: Papizza shop, pizza diki ine diameter ye10 cm inodhura 12000원 uye pizza huru ine diameter ye20 cm inodhura 24000원. Yunho akati, “Pizza huru ine diameter nguva 2 nemutengo nguva 2, saka yakaenzana nemapizza madiki 2.” Yuna akanyora chigadziriso chekuongorora (shandisa 3.14 sepi; zvikamu zvenzvimbo i cm²).
x-m-e6-08.prereq.1: Pi se3.14 nenzira yekuwana nzvimbo yedenderedzwa (Grade 6)
x-m-e6-08.s.s1.hint.0: Isa mitsara inowana nzvimbo dzemapizza maviri padivi nedivi uye ufananidze kana nhamba yakawanzwa iri radius kana diameter.
x-m-e6-08.s.s1.hint.1: Pamutsara wega wega, fananidza radius yawakasarudza pakutanga nenhamba yawakawanza pakuwana nzvimbo.
x-m-e6-08.s.s1.line.0: Radius yepizza diki i5 cm uye radius yepizza huru i10 cm.
x-m-e6-08.s.s1.line.3: 1256 ÷ 78.5 = 16, saka pizza huru i nguva 16 yepizza diki.
x-m-e6-08.s.s1.line.4: Saka pizza huru imwe yakaenzana nemapizza madiki 16.
x-m-e6-08.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 3 ndiyo nzvimbo yekutanga isiri iyo. Mumutsara 1 radius yepizza huru yakaiswa se10 cm, asi mumutsara 3 diameter 20 yakawanzwa. 10 × 10 × 3.14 = 314 yakarurama. Mitsara 4 ne5 yakatevera kukosha kwakaipa kwemutsara 3.
x-m-e6-08.s.s2.prompt: Zvino kuti chigadziriso chaYuna chagadziriswa, kune 24000원, ndeipi inopa pizza yakawanda: pizza huru imwe here kana mapizza madiki maviri?
x-m-e6-08.s.s2.hint.0: Uchishandisa makoshero akagadziriswa, wana nzvimbo yepizza huru imwe nepizza diki imwe.
x-m-e6-08.s.s2.hint.1: Fananidza nzvimbo dzose dzenzira mbiri dzekushandisa 24000원.
x-m-e6-08.s.s2.o.a: Pizza huru imwe ndiyo yakawanda. Izvi nokuti nzvimbo i nguva 4
x-m-e6-08.s.s2.r.a: Wakashandisa nzvimbo, kwete diameter, sehwaro hwekufananidza.
x-m-e6-08.s.s2.o.b: Zviviri zvakaenzana. Izvi nokuti diameter i nguva 2, saka nzvimbo inovawo nguva 2
x-m-e6-08.s.s2.r.b: Wakashandura chokwadi chekuti diameter i nguva 2 kuita nzvimbo i nguva 2. Funga nezvechokwadi chekuti radius inowanzwa kaviri.
x-m-e6-08.s.s2.o.c: Mapizza madiki maviri anopa zvakawanda. Nokuti pane mapizza akawanda
x-m-e6-08.s.s2.r.c: Wakatarisa huwandu hwemapizza chete. Unofanira kufananidza kuti hukuru hwepizza imwe neimwe hwakasiyana sei.
x-m-e6-08.s.s2.explain: Pizza imwe diki ndi 78.5 cm² uye pizza imwe huru ndi 314 cm², iri nguva 4 yakawanda. Mapizza maviri madiki ndi 157 cm², saka pizza imwe huru inopa zvakawanda.
x-m-e6-08.s.s3.prompt: Tsanangura kuti sei, kana diameter (radius) ichiva nguva 2 huru, nzvimbo yedenderedzwa isingaiti nguva 2 huru asi inova huru kupfuura izvozvo.
x-m-e6-08.s.s3.hint.0: Enzanisa kuti chirevo chekuwanza chakashanduka sei kana radius yaiva 5 ikaenda kusvika pa 10.
x-m-e6-08.s.s3.hint.1: Isa mumazwi ako kuti radius inowanzwa nguva ngani.
x-m-e6-08.s.s3.placeholder: Semuenzaniso: Kana radius ichiva nguva 2 huru, ...
x-m-e6-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Chikonzero chako chinosanganisira here “radius inowanzwa kaviri”?
x-m-e6-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakafungidzira here kuti nzvimbo yaizova nguva ngani huru kana diameter yaiva nguva 3 huru?
x-m-e6-08.s.s3.model.0: Kana radius ichiva nguva 2 huru, radius inowanzwa kaviri, saka nzvimbo inova 2×2=nguva 4 huru. 5×5×3.14=78.5 ne 10×10×3.14=314.

x-m-e6-09.thinking.1: Tsvaga mhinduro dzakati wandei dzinosangana nemamiriro
x-m-e6-09.s.s1.prompt: Chirevo chipi chinoratidza zvakarurama nzvimbo yenzira yakatenderera?

x-m-e6-09.s.s1.r.c: Izvi zvakafanana nefomula yekutenderera kwedenderedzwa. Kune nzvimbo, radius inowanzwa kaviri.
x-m-e6-09.s.s1.explain: Nzvimbo yenzira = nzvimbo yedenderedzwa rekunze − nzvimbo yedziva = 3.14 × R × R − 3.14 × r × r.
x-m-e6-09.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga (R, r) 2 dzakasiyana dzinoita nzvimbo yenzira ive 75.36 m². Sezvo pane dziva, r ndi 1 kana kupfuura.

x-m-e6-09.s.s2.hint.1: Shandura r imwe imwe uye utarise kuti R×R − r×r inofanira kuva chii.

x-m-e6-09.s.s2.fail.c1: R inofanira kuva nhamba yakazara ye 20 kana pasi uye r nhamba yakazara ye 1 kana kupfuura.

x-m-e6-09.s.s2.explain: 75.36 ÷ 3.14 = 24, saka unongoda nhamba dzakazara dzine R×R − r×r = 24. 7×7 − 5×5 = 24 uye 5×5 − 1×1 = 24. Upamhi ndi 2 m ne 4 m zvichiteverana.
x-m-e6-09.s.s2.because.prompt: Mumhinduro mbiri upamhi hwenzira hwakasiyana asi nzvimbo yakanga yakafanana. Tsanangura kuti sei izvi zvichibvira.
x-m-e6-09.s.s2.because.hint.0: Tsvaga upamhi (R − r) hwemhinduro mbiri uye uhuenzanise.
x-m-e6-09.s.s2.because.hint.1: Rangarira kuti radius inowanzwa kangani kana uchiwana nzvimbo yedenderedzwa.
x-m-e6-09.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakagadzira here mumwe muenzaniso apo upamhi hwakafanana asi nzvimbo dzisina kufanana?
x-m-e6-09.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakataura here kuti sei nzvimbo inokura zvakasiyana kunzira yemukati nenzira yekunze?
x-m-e6-09.s.s2.because.model.0: Nzvimbo inowanikwa nekuita square radius, saka kunyange neupamhi hwakafanana, nzvimbo inova huru kure kure uchienda. Saka upamhi hwakasiyana hunogona kupa nzvimbo imwe chete.
x-m-e6-09.s.s2.because.model.1: Nzvimbo yedenderedzwa inoenderana neradius yakawanzwa kaviri, saka kunyange nzira yakatetepa (7−5=2 m) inogona kuva nenzvimbo imwe chete nenzira yemukati yeupamhi hwe 4 m (5−1) kana iri kure, nokuti nzvimbo ipapo yakakura.

x-m-e6-01.title: Kutarisa kugovanisa fractions kwaMinseo

x-m-e6-01.material: Minseo akaverenga 3/4 ÷ 2/3 (nhatu pamana yakagovaniswa nembiri pamatatu), asi mudzidzisi akati, “Mhinduro yako yakasiyana.” Pazasi pane gadziriso yaMinseo. Verenga ma fractions mumashoko, sa “nhatu pamana.”

x-m-e6-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse wekutanga usina kururama mugadziriso yaMinseo.
x-m-e6-01.s.s1.hint.0: Tevera kuti mutsetse mumwe nemumwe wakabva sei kumutsetse wakamberi pakarepo.
x-m-e6-01.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kuti nhamba dzipi dzakachinjwa, uye kana nhamba mbiri dzakachinjwa.
x-m-e6-01.s.s1.line.1: Chinjanisa numerator ne denominator ye divisor 2/3 uye unyore 3/2.
x-m-e6-01.s.s1.line.2: Chinjanisawo numerator ne denominator ye dividend 3/4 uye unyore 4/3.
x-m-e6-01.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 3 ndiwo nzvimbo yekutanga isina kururama. Divisor 2/3 chete ndiyo inofanira kuchinjwa; dividend 3/4 inofanira kuramba sezvayakaita. Kuverenga kwemutsetse 4 kwakangotevera mutsetse 3.
x-m-e6-01.s.s2.prompt: Ndeipi nzira yakanaka yekutarisa kuti mhinduro yaMinseo 2 haina kururama?
x-m-e6-01.s.s2.hint.0: Funga kuti ndekuverenga kupi kwawakashandisa kutarisa kana mhinduro yakarurama.
x-m-e6-01.s.s2.hint.1: Kune sarudzo imwe neimwe, funga kana kuita kutarisa uku kwaizoratidza kukanganisa kwaMinseo kana kwaizodzokorora kukanganisa kumwechete.
x-m-e6-01.s.s2.o.a: Mhinduro 2 i nhamba yakazara uye inoratidzika yakanaka, saka pamwe yakarurama
x-m-e6-01.s.s2.r.a: Mhinduro kuoneka yakanaka hazvisi humbowo hwekuti yakarurama. Unofanira kutarisa mhinduro yekugovanisa nekuverenga.
x-m-e6-01.s.s2.o.b: Tanga waenzanisa kuti ndeipi hombe nekuwana common denominator ye 3/4 ne 2/3
x-m-e6-01.s.s2.r.b: Kuwana common denominator i nzira yekuenzanisa hukuru hwema fractions maviri. Haikuudzi kana mhinduro yekugovanisa yakarurama.
x-m-e6-01.s.s2.o.c: Dzokorora kuverenga kwaMinseo kamwe zvakare nenhevedzano imwechete uone kana 2 ichibuda zvakare
x-m-e6-01.s.s2.r.c: Kana ukadzokorora nenzira imwechete, kukanganisa kumwechete kunodzokororwa sezvakaita. Hazvikuudzi kana nzira pachayo yakarurama.
x-m-e6-01.s.s2.o.d: Wanza 2 ne divisor 2/3 uye utarise kana inova 3/4
x-m-e6-01.s.s2.r.d: Yakashandisa hukama hwekuti mhinduro yekugovanisa inogona kudzoserwa nekuwanza.
x-m-e6-01.s.s2.explain: Quotient yakawanzwa ne divisor inofanira kuenzana ne dividend. 2 × 2/3 = 4/3, iyo isiri 3/4, saka 2 i mhinduro isina kururama.
x-m-e6-01.s.s3.prompt: Nyora mhinduro yakarurama ye 3/4 ÷ 2/3, uye utsanangure mumitsara mumwe kana miviri kuti Minseo akachinja chii zvisina kururama uye sei.

x-m-e6-01.s.s3.model.0: 3/4 × 3/2 = 9/8 = 1 1/8. Divisor 2/3 chete ndiyo inoshandurwa kuita 3/2, asi Minseo akashandura 3/4 zvakare, saka zvaiva zvisina kururama.
x-m-e6-01.s.s3.model.1: Divisor chete ndiyo inotsinhirwa, saka inova 3/4 × 3/2 uye mhinduro ndi9/8, ndiko kuti, 1 ne1/8. Minseo akatsinhirawo nhamba yekutanga.
x-m-e6-01.s.s3.model.2: 3/4×3/2=9/8. Minseo aisafanira kushandura dividend, asi akaishandura.
